context: A teacher walks a teen through industry research
purpose: Teach: トヨタ自動車/最年少/サバイバル/プラネタリウム/温存/微細/立て続け/頑丈

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本気で、絶対、トヨタ自動車、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, you really handled Toyota in your research — I was genuinely impressed by the depth of it.
lines.style: Warm recognition with a slight pause for emphasis. Measured cadence. Sincere admiration, not performance. Leaning in slightly as if sharing an observation she wants to land.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。業界の、本気で、絶対、最年少、絶対、経営者、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to explore how the youngest executives in the industry shaped the company's direction. I'm grateful for the chance to research something so complex.
lines.style: Formal politeness with genuine warmth underneath. Measured pacing. Careful articulation of gratitude — not reflexive, but deliberate. A quiet strength in how she holds her words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後企業の、本気で、絶対、サバイバル、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you framed postwar corporate survival was striking — your perspective was remarkably broad and mature.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself but speaking it aloud. Slight pause before key words like 'striking.' Warm approval tempered with genuine intellectual recognition. Eyes tracking her own thoughts.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。教育施設の、本気で、絶対、プラネタリウム、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I found the planetarium section of the research especially meaningful — it showed how they invested in education and community, not just profit.
lines.style: Steady voice, intentional. She's explaining something she cares about without needing validation. Slight uplift at the end, opening the thought rather than closing it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統技能の、本気で、絶対、温存、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And how you traced the preservation of traditional skills through their manufacturing — that was the kind of detail that shows real understanding.
lines.style: Genuine delight in noticing something good. Unhurried. A teacher speaking to a student she respects as a thinker. Slight warmth in the voice, not gushy, just real.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。半導体の、本気で、絶対、微細、絶対、加工、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I wanted to show that even in semiconductor production, there's precision rooted in craft tradition. That connection felt important to understand.
lines.style: Confident without arrogance. She's explaining her choices clearly. Deliberate pacing. Slight emphasis on 'connection' — this is what mattered to her about the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、立て続け、絶対、の合併、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the rapid mergers and industry consolidation — you didn't just list them, you traced how they shaped the company's identity.
lines.style: Appreciative, measured. Speaking from careful thought. Slight nod in the voice. Recognition of complexity understood, not oversimplified. Genuine respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。建築の、本気で、絶対、頑丈、絶対、設計、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. And I wanted to end with how their building design philosophy reflected all of that — robustness and longevity, not just functionality. That felt like the right conclusion.
lines.style: Thoughtful closure. Slightly slower pacing on the final phrases. Confidence in her own analytical choices. A quiet satisfaction that the pieces came together meaningfully.
